subject: Mental Models
title: Compounding
description: A fast breakdown of Compounding for builders.

hook.text: One cent doubled every day for thirty days becomes over five million dollars. The magic is not in the penny.

buildup.text: Compounding means growth builds on prior growth. Small consistent gains accumulate into enormous results over time.

discovery.text: Albert Einstein reportedly called compound interest the eighth wonder of the world. Those who understand it earn.

twist.text: Compounding is counterintuitive. Most of Warren Buffett's wealth was earned after his 65th birthday.

climax.text: Find areas where your efforts compound. Knowledge, relationships, savings, and reputation all compound.

punchline.text: Small gains stacked over time create fortunes.

quiz.question: What makes compounding powerful?
options: Growth building on prior growth over time
